newsitem.title: USA: Secom completes brake unit acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Secom completes brake unit acquisition.

text.p: Secom General Corp said Friday it has acquired the assets and operations of the VarityKelsey-Hayes Machining facility in Milford, Mich.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
The facility manufactures various machined brake valve parts with an estimated $12 million in annual sales, Secom said.
The parties also executed a five-year supply agreement covering the continuing supply of parts from the acquired Milford unit to VarityKelsey-Hayes, Secom said.
"We expect the Milford operation to make a significant contribution to the consolidated profitability of Secom in 1997 and thereafter," said Secom's chief financial officer David Marczak.
VarityKelsey-Hayes is a business unit of LucasVarity Plc .
